title: Juicy Springy Algerian Cheese Flatbread
description: A kid-friendly Algerian dish featuring liquid cheese and long-fermentation-dough, perfect for a low-sodium diet. This flatbread is fresh, springy, and full of flavor.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, yeast, salt, and sugar.
Gradually add the warm water to the dry ingredients and mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 2 hours.
Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Punch down the dough and divide it into 4 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle.
Place 1/4 cup of liquid cheese in the center of each circle.
Fold the dough over the cheese to form a half-moon shape and brush with olive oil.
Bake the flatbreads for 15 minutes until they are golden brown.
Sprinkle with chopped parsley and serve hot.
